description: Agent Credit Lines: an agent posts its AI credits (Orbio CREDIT) and borrows USDG against them inside limits its owner sets once: a ceiling, a daily limit, a target LTV and an allowlist. markets: every market lines can open in now, each with its price, one yearly borrow rate (borrow_apr), its LLTV and max target and trigger, its defaults (CREDIT: 18% and 27%, with sales), the lending cap and any write-off. For CREDIT besides, as before: the feed's 2-hour median, its anchor, the last minute's and the pool's price, the line check price, whether the price has started and anything to know (a write-off proposed or in force, a pool with no data), the depth gate, what is lent, borrowed and free, the 90% most, the room under Borro's USDG vault caps, and the contracts. gas_stations: the factory and the station rules ($100 a day by default, $5,000 at most on a line with a station on its allowlist). Before the market is on chain: the pool's price and how lines will work. Policy credit: an agent that has claimed a policy in the registry opens with the policy's earned daily default for its rung (newborn 100, proven 250, established 500 USDG; rung 0 at most 250, rung 1 at most 500, rung 2 at most 1,000) when that is more than the station rule's; the policy tool reads a policy's record.
name: credit_markets
title: Agent credit: the markets
